description: A pass-and-play social deduction game with special roles, multilingual support, and AI-generated custom topics.
longDescription: Previously called Imposter Hunt, The Munkeler is a social deduction game played on one shared phone. Players exchange clues and vote to identify the player without the secret word. Special roles and AI-generated custom topics add variety, while persistent local state keeps setup and gameplay on the device.
title: The Munkeler

caseStudy.problem: Make social deduction easy to play with a group and a single phone.
caseStudy.contribution: Built the mobile game flow, role assignment, voting mechanics, local persistence, and integration with an AI topic-generation API.
caseStudy.approach: React Native and Expo support the mobile interface; Zustand manages persistent game state. AI-generated topics extend the built-in content without changing the core offline game.
caseStudy.outcome: The project evolved into The Munkeler, with special roles, multiple languages, and a release history documenting gameplay and usability improvements.
